definition: Existing compare_conditions applied separately per scenario; no new simulations.

definitions.paired_unit: one run per (scenario, seed); only pairs present in both conditions are used
definitions.success_test: exact two-sided McNemar/binomial test on discordant pairs
definitions.metric_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, normal approximation with tie/zero correction
definitions.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap of the mean difference, seeded RNG
definitions.effect_size: Cliff's delta = P(condition > baseline) - P(condition < baseline)
definitions.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni within each condition family (success + metrics)
